DIAGNOSIS READY: Stasis Dermatitis with Secondary Cellulitis secondary to Chronic Venous Insufficiency.

The wound culture and blood work I just ordered will help confirm the infection, but your family history of similar leg problems, combined with the 10-year history of swelling and prior DVT, strongly points to venous insufficiency causing stasis dermatitis. The hardening of the skin you mentioned is likely lipodermatosclerosis, a classic sign of this condition.
